rows.note: Use 完全 as the all-purpose adverb for totality, including being completely broke.
Use 床單 for the flat sheet placed on a bed.

example.english: I changed the flat sheet today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 wun6 zo2 zoeng1 cong4 daan1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for level ground and a smooth, even surface.
Use 直頭 for an outright or blunt refusal, statement, or opposition rather than mere totality.

example.english: They gave me a flat refusal to help.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zik6 tau4 m4 hang2 bong1 ngo5

rows.note: Use 爆胎 for a punctured or flat vehicle or bicycle tyre.

example.english: My bicycle has a flat tyre.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaa3 daan1 ce1 baau3 toi1 laa3

rows.note: Use it for a deflated tire, and for a drink that has lost its fizz.

example.english: The car tire is flat now.
example.jyutping: go3 ce1 toi1 mou5 hei3 laa3

rows.note: Use 平底鞋 for ladies’ shoes with little or no heel.

example.english: I like wearing flat shoes to work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 gung1 zung1 ji3 zoek3 ping4 dai2 haai4

rows.note: Use it when an event or situation feels boring and lifeless.
Use this resultative construction when an action leaves something flat or level.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 zoeng1 zi2 aat3 ping4

rows.note: Use it when a battery or device has no power left.

example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 mou5 din6 laa3

rows.note: Use this after a measurement to say it is exactly that amount, with no extra fraction.

example.english: I paid one hundred dollars flat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 zo2 jat1 baak3 man1 zing2

rows.note: Use 降號 for the musical flat sign or the note lowered by that sign.

example.english: This note needs a flat sign.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jam1 jiu3 gaa1 gong3 hou6
